scenarios.prompt: Reserve a reaction region and select one eligible target event using stable session/trigger identity and authored deterministic priority, then emit one ranged action request.

criteria.identity: Overwatch session, region revision, trigger ID and resulting action request are explicit.
criteria.determinism: Simultaneous eligible targets resolve through authored priority/tie-break rather than callback order.
criteria.evidence: Readiness is consumed at most once and ranged resolution remains in projectile-hitscan.
